thag2.49:1.1: Assatthe haritobhāse saṃvirūḷhamhi pādape ekaṃ buddhagataṃ saññaṃ alabhitthaṃ patissato. || ||
thag2.49:2.1: ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ saññaṃ alabhin tadā, tassā saññāya vāhasā patto me āsavakkhayo 'ti. || || Sandhito thero. Pañcamo
thag2.49:3.0: vaggo. uddānaṃ: Kumārakassapo thero Dhammapālo ca Brahmāli Mogharājā Visākho ca Cūḷako ca Anūpamo Vajjito Sandhito thero kilesarajavāhano 'ti. | gāthā Dukanipātamhi
thag2.49:4.0: navuti c' eva aṭṭha ca, therā ekūnapaññāsaṃ bhāsitā nayakovidā. |
